hook: SimDrop - Running iOS simulators in the macOS Finder sidebar
hookText: SimDrop - Running iOS simulators in the macOS Finder sidebar

beats.say: Shows running iOS simulators in the Finder sidebar so you can drag files in and out of them.
SimDrop isn't on the Mac App Store and can't be: the app and its helper must run unsandboxed to drive simctl and the simulators' folders.
Replacing the app makes macOS drop its Finder extension and stop the background helper. launchd refuses to start a helper whose recorded launch constraint came from the old copy.
